001package com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.intel.raid;
002
003import java.awt.Color;
004import java.util.List;
005
006import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.SectorEntityToken;
007import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.DebugFlags;
008import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.fleets.RouteLocationCalculator;
009import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.fleets.RouteManager;
010import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.fleets.RouteManager.RouteData;
011import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.fleets.RouteManager.RouteSegment;
012import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.intel.inspection.HITravelStage;
013import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.intel.punitive.PETravelStage;
014import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.intel.raid.RaidIntel.RaidStageStatus;
015import com.fs.starfarer.api.ui.TooltipMakerAPI;
016import com.fs.starfarer.api.util.Misc;
017
018public class TravelStage extends BaseRaidStage {
019
020        protected SectorEntityToken from;
021        protected SectorEntityToken to;
022        protected boolean requireNearTarget;
023
024
025        public TravelStage(RaidIntel raid, SectorEntityToken from, SectorEntityToken to, boolean requireNearTarget) {
026                super(raid);
027                this.from = from;
028                this.to = to;
029                this.requireNearTarget = requireNearTarget;
030        }
031
032        @Override
033        public void notifyStarted() {
034                updateRoutes();
035        }
036
037
038        protected void updateRoutes() {
039                resetRoutes();
040                
041                List<RouteData> routes = RouteManager.getInstance().getRoutesForSource(intel.getRouteSourceId());
042                for (RouteData route : routes) {
043                        float travelDays = RouteLocationCalculator.getTravelDays(from, to);
044                        if (DebugFlags.RAID_DEBUG || DebugFlags.FAST_RAIDS || 
045                                        (this instanceof PETravelStage && DebugFlags.PUNITIVE_EXPEDITION_DEBUG) ||
046                                        (this instanceof HITravelStage && DebugFlags.HEGEMONY_INSPECTION_DEBUG)
047                                        ) {
048                                travelDays *= 0.1f;
049                        }
050                        
051                        route.addSegment(new RouteSegment(travelDays, from, to));
052                        route.addSegment(new RouteSegment(1000f, to, AssembleStage.WAIT_STAGE));
053                        
054                        maxDays = Math.max(maxDays, travelDays);
055                }
056        }
057        
058        protected void updateStatus() {
059                abortIfNeededBasedOnFP(true);
060                updateStatusBasedOnReaching(to, true, requireNearTarget);
061        }
062        
063        public void showStageInfo(TooltipMakerAPI info) {
064                int curr = intel.getCurrentStage();
065                int index = intel.getStageIndex(this);
066                
067                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
068                Color g = Misc.getGrayColor();
069                Color tc = Misc.getTextColor();
070                float pad = 3f;
071                float opad = 10f;
072                
073                if (status == RaidStageStatus.FAILURE) {
074                        info.addPara("The raiding forces have failed to successfully reach the " +
075                                        intel.getSystem().getNameWithLowercaseType() + ". The raid is now over.", opad);
076                } else if (curr == index) {
077                        info.addPara("The raiding forces are currently travelling to the " + 
078                                        intel.getSystem().getNameWithLowercaseType() + ".", opad);
079                }
080        }
081}
